title: 3 faux plant set
text: 3 faux plant set. These are very cute... but a little too shiny.  The pic does show they are shiny, but I missed that... they would look a bit more real if they weren't so shiny!  Regardless, they are nice little green spots.  They are about 7 or 8" tall... the clear pots are glass, about 3x3?  They are nice piece of spring! And guaranteed no watering necessary... just a little dusting every so often.

product_metadata.title: MyGift Set of 3 Artificial Plants, Faux Tabletop Greenery w/Clear Glass Pots
features: A trio of realistic faux plants in clear glass cube pots
The set features 1 simulation taro plant, 1 artificial lotus plant, and 1 faux clover plant
Perfect for desktops, coffee tables, counter spaces, and shelves
**Official MyGift product includes microfiber polishing cloth.**
Approximate Dimensions (each pot, in inches): Taro Plant - 6.25 W X 9.5 H X 5.5 D; Lotus Plant - 5.5 W X 8.75 H X 4 D; Clover Plant - 4.5 W X 9 H X 3.25 D.
